title: Albert Bender's three men in black teleport him to Antarctica

tellings.quote: these three men in black materialized in his attic. And he said they had he said they had glowing orange eyes and they smelled like sulfur

plain: In the 1950s, a man named Albert Bender said three "men in black" appeared out of thin air in his attic. These were mysterious visitors in dark suits, and he said they had glowing orange eyes, smelled of sulfur, and later took him to Antarctica in an instant. The researcher Jason Jorjani retells this from Bender's own book, The Saucers and the Three Men.
